name: Dutch National Flag
description: Sorts an array of three distinct values (0s, 1s, 2s) in a single pass using three pointers. Also known as 3-way partitioning.
aim: Partition array into three sections [0s | 1s | 2s] in O(n) time and O(1) space using lo, mid, and hi pointers.

realWorld: Sorting RGB pixels by red/green/blue flag
whenToUse: Partition array into exactly three groups in one pass
Base for 3-way QuickSort on arrays with many duplicates
alternatives: Counting sort — O(n+k), works for any k values
Standard sort — O(n log n), not necessary for 3 values
Two-pass partition — simpler but requires 2 passes
